chunks: Muhammad b. al-Hasan b. Ahmad b. al-Walid (may Allah be pleased with him) narrated to us. He said: Muhammad b. al-Hasan al-Saffar narrated to us. He said: Ahmad b. Isa from al-Hasan b. Ali b. Faddal, from Marwan b. Muslim. He said: Abu Abdillah Jafar b. Muhammad al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) said: My father narrated to me from his forefathers (peace be upon them) from the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and his family). He said:

Allah, exalted is His Majesty, said: Whichever servant obeys Me, I do not assign him to other than Me. And whichever servant disobeys Me, I assign him to himself, then I do not care in which valley he perishes.

key_terms.أكله إلى غيري: I do not assign him to other than Me -- God personally takes care of the obedient
key_terms.لم أبال: I do not care -- divine indifference to the fate of the disobedient
key_terms.وكلته إلى نفسه: I assign him to himself -- abandoned to his own inadequate resources

ai.seo_question: What is the hadith qudsi about divine protection for obedient servants and abandonment of disobedient ones?
ai.summary: This is a hadith qudsi (divine speech) narrated through the prophetic chain via Imam al-Sadiq (AS). God declares that He personally protects and guides the obedient servant, never leaving them to rely on others. But the disobedient servant is abandoned to his own devices, and God is indifferent to his fate. The original audience understood this as a warning that divine protection is conditional on obedience, and that self-reliance without God leads to destruction.
